project_context.target_audience: Greek law firm (Σκοτάνης & Συνεργάτες) executives and accountants
project_context.core_aesthetic: Tremendous aesthetics and ultra-expensive taste (γλύκανε το UI κάνε το πανέμορφο με τρομερή αισθητική και πανάκριβο γούστο). Refined luxury, Old Money Tech.

brand_headings.usage: Brand logo, Page Titles, Large KPI figures (non-financial), Hero text.

ui_body.usage: General UI text, labels, paragraphs, table data.

data_numbers.usage: Financial numbers, VAT rates, IDs, tabular data, exact euro alignments.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid var(--gold-border-thin). Do not use generic grey borders. All structural lines must have a hint of gold.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Crystal Glass. Backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-xl), slight saturation boost, and a 1px delicate inner stroke of gold/10. NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds for headers/dropdowns.
visual_enhancers.ornaments: Use the diamond symbol (◆) in pale gold (text-primary/40) as elegant separators in the topbar or footers, echoing the premium letterhead.

layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento-style grids. High Density for data, wide gaps for summaries. md:grid-cols-4 with gap-6. Use col-span logic for 6-month chart (col-span-3) and myDATA panel (col-span-1).
layouts.sidebar: Grouped navigation. Active links should feature a thin left gold border (border-l-2 border-primary) and a very subtle gold gradient background (bg-gradient-to-r from-primary/10 to-transparent).
layouts.topbar: Glassmorphic background (z-50, backdrop-blur-md, bg-background/80). Must not be transparent. Must contain a live clock (IBM Plex Sans, subtle text) and User Avatar with a thin gold ring.

cards.style: Flat dark navy background (bg-card) with border-primary/10. Hover state lifts slightly (-translate-y-1) and increases border opacity to primary/30 with a soft black shadow.

buttons.primary: Solid gold (bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-medium). Hover: brighter gold with a subtle glow shadow.
buttons.secondary: Transparent with thin gold border (border border-primary/30 text-primary). Hover: bg-primary/10.

tables.header: Border-bottom thin gold (border-b border-primary/20). Text uppercase, tracking-wider, text-xs, text-muted-foreground.
tables.rows: Hover effect (hover:bg-primary/5). Financial numbers strictly right-aligned using JetBrains Mono.

badges.style: Pill-shaped, extremely subtle background. e.g., bg-primary/10 text-primary border border-primary/20.

motion.staggered_entrance: Use Framer Motion to stagger dashboard cards and table rows on load. initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ staggerChildren: 0.1 }}.
motion.micro_interactions: All buttons, table rows, and interactive elements must have a 0.2s ease transition on hover.

pages.dashboard: KPI cards top row. 6-month Bar Chart (Recharts, gold bars with opacity, white tooltips). myDATA pending panel.
pages.invoices: Table with MARK status badges. Actions column with PDF icon and Mail icon. One-click email to client. Invoice creation dialog with voice-command button (glow effect when listening).
pages.expenses: Upload zone with dashed gold/30 border. OCR preview panel side-by-side with data form.
pages.payroll: Detailed breakdown using monospace font for exact euro alignments.
pages.tax_calendar: Timeline or grid view. Upcoming deadlines highlighted with a glowing gold dot.

image_urls.description: Professional man in suit in dark room. Perfect for the topbar user avatar (Σκοτάνης & Συνεργάτες).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-to-background ratio is at least 4.5:1. Use muted gold for borders but brighter gold for text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='invoice-download-btn'`).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Use specific properties.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds for headers, dropdowns, or modals.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
Do not use generic UI placeholder text; utilize Greek copywriting appropriate for accounting (e.g., 'Έσοδα', 'Έξοδα', 'ΦΠΑ').
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement these tokens by updating the CSS variables in the primary CSS file (index.css) to match the dark navy and gold palette. Update Tailwind config if necessary to extend colors and fonts. Refactor shadcn/ui components (cards, buttons, tables, badges) to use 'Crystal Glass' and 'Thin Gold Rule' aesthetics. Ensure typography classes (font-serif, font-sans, font-mono) are properly applied. Add Framer Motion staggered entrance animations. Add data-testids to all interactive elements.
